body: Bug: this drops the first (newest, per the sort above) entry from the feed. Both the PR description and the work item spec say `listChangelogEntries()` should simply be `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)` with no slicing. Since no test calls `listChangelogEntries()` directly (all 6 new tests exercise `buildChangelogFeed` with fixtures), this regression slipped past `npm run test`. Please remove `.slice(1)`.

Fixed in a85aa03 — removed the `.slice(1)` so `listChangelogEntries()` now returns `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)` unmodified, matching the PR description and work item spec. Also added a test (`listChangelogEntries returns the full combined feed from the real registry with no entries dropped`) that calls `listChangelogEntries()` directly against the real registry and asserts entry count/parity with `buildChangelogFeed`, so this regression is now caught by `npm run test`.
